families.question: 按客户统计订单金额和回款金额
families.candidate_sql: SELECT c.id, SUM(o.amount) AS order_amount, SUM(p.amount) AS paid_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id
families.repair_sql: WITH order_sum AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS order_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id), payment_sum AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_amount FROM payments GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.id, COALESCE(o.order_amount,0), COALESCE(p.paid_amount,0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN order_sum o ON o.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN payment_sum p ON p.customer_id=c.id ORDER BY c.id
families.gold_sql: WITH order_sum AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS order_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id), payment_sum AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_amount FROM payments GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.id, COALESCE(o.order_amount,0), COALESCE(p.paid_amount,0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN order_sum o ON o.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN payment_sum p ON p.customer_id=c.id ORDER BY c.id
